_comment: The App-master bench baseline — the sweep result a change must not regress below. Until this file existed, the sweep verdict lived in a COMMIT BODY ('R2 green 6/6, sweep #23'): the next agent could only learn it by reading git log, and nothing could fail when it went backwards. `npm run bench:gate` reads the newest run per scenario out of bench/app-master/runs/, compares it here, writes bench/app-master/gate.json, and exits non-zero on a regression. Update this file in the SAME change that legitimately moves a number, and say which number moved and why.
_requiredExpectations: Names the checks that must still be MEASURED — an expectation quietly dropped from a scenario file is a coverage regression that a pass/fail count cannot see (unmeasured is not zero).
_metrics: schemaVersion 2 adds NUMBERS, because `mustPass` + `requiredExpectations` let a tenure fall from five opened proposals to one and still pass green: every expectation was measured, every one met its floor, and nothing anywhere compared the run to the last one. Each entry is `atLeast` (higher is better) or `atMost` (lower is better), read out of the run record at the same paths REPORT.md reads (the busiest night's `reading` / `backbone`). `tolerance` is a FRACTION of the bar, so a metric that wobbles run to run does not cry wolf; an absent metric is a problem, never a zero. `metricsFrom` is where the numbers came from and is not optional — a bar with no stated origin is a number somebody made up, and this file exists to stop exactly that.
_metricsGap: `metrics: null` means NOBODY HAS MEASURED THIS SCENARIO into a committed artifact — it is not 'nothing to write'. Only kp-default has one: `__fixtures__/result-stub.json`, the recorded run report.test.mjs is built on. Those numbers came from the in-process STUB Personas, so they are canned by construction and the gate refuses a stub run outright (verdict `stub`); they are a FLOOR the shape of a real sweep, not a live measurement, and the first live sweep should re-record them with `metricsFrom` naming its run. The other five stay honest at null until a sweep is committed for them.
